experiments.purpose: Measure the controlled dueling-architecture effect under the Vanilla Bellman target at training seed 42.

reference.description: Archived deterministic Vanilla DQN A42 reference.

screening_rule.description: Manual architecture-ablation screen against A42 and replication-eligibility screen against the A44 balanced leader.
manual_criteria: Against A42, material improvement requires combined mean reward at least 235.12 or solved count at least 124/150; the other primary metric should remain approximately non-inferior.
Maximum same-side-engine streak must be below 100.
Neither Benchmark A nor Benchmark B may contain a severe isolated regression hidden by the combined result.
A44 balanced-leader reference: mean reward 237.929; solved 134/150 (89.33%); low 0/150; mean length 283.11; timeouts 1/150.

A seed-42 challenger can only earn replication, never replace A44 directly. Eligibility requires either mean reward at least 242.929 with solved count at least 131/150, or solved count at least 142/150 with mean reward at least 235.929.

Replication eligibility additionally requires at most 1 negative episode, at most 3 timeouts, mean length at most 297.27, maximum same-side-engine streak below 100, and acceptable performance on both Benchmark A and Benchmark B.
All screening decisions are manual; no threshold authorizes automatic follow-up.

experiments.purpose: Complete the seed-42 architecture-by-target ablation using the identical dueling network with the Double DQN Bellman target.

reference.description: Archived deterministic Double DQN seed-42 reference; its maximum same-side-engine streak was 502.

screening_rule.description: Manual pathology-repair screen against Double42 and replication-eligibility screen against the A44 balanced leader.
manual_criteria: Against Double42, combined mean reward must be at least approximately 234.61 and solved count must be at least 123/150.
Maximum same-side-engine streak must be below 100; the Double42 reference maximum was 502.
Performance must remain acceptable on both Benchmark A and Benchmark B rather than relying on one benchmark set.
A44 balanced-leader reference: mean reward 237.929; solved 134/150 (89.33%); low 0/150; mean length 283.11; timeouts 1/150.

A seed-42 challenger can only earn replication, never replace A44 directly. Eligibility requires either mean reward at least 242.929 with solved count at least 131/150, or solved count at least 142/150 with mean reward at least 235.929.

Replication eligibility additionally requires at most 1 negative episode, at most 3 timeouts, mean length at most 297.27, maximum same-side-engine streak below 100, and acceptable performance on both Benchmark A and Benchmark B.
All screening decisions are manual; no threshold authorizes automatic follow-up.
